Writing mirrors reading: stream CoT for live events, or persist structured content through the Marti API. Confirm exact request bodies in the spec; every request carries your mTLS client certificate, and what you write is scoped to the groups you send to.

Sending live CoT

The most direct way to put a position/marker/chat onto the map of every connected client is to send CoT over the streaming connection (the same link you subscribe on). As an integrating service you connect as a client and emit CoT events; they fan out to clients in the groups you write to.

For ingest from external systems, TAK Server can also pull/accept events through configured inputs and data feeds:

  • PUT /Marti/api/inputs/{id}, GET/PUT /Marti/api/inputs/config — manage inputs.
  • GET/PUT/POST/DELETE /Marti/api/datafeeds/{name}, PUT/POST /Marti/api/datafeeds/predicate — manage data feeds and their predicates.
  • GET/PUT/POST /Marti/api/outgoingconnections — push events to external endpoints.

Creating & updating missions

To share structured content with a team, write to a mission:

  • POST / PUT /Marti/api/missions/{name} — create or update a mission (DELETE to remove).
  • PUT /Marti/api/missions/{name}/contents — add content (e.g. references to Enterprise Sync hashes); DELETE to remove content.
  • PUT /Marti/api/missions/{name}/contents/missionpackage — add a Mission Package (a zipped data package) to the mission.
  • Manage layers (/maplayers, /layers), keywords, invites (/invite/{type}/{invitee}), password, expiration, and nesting (/parent/{parentName}) via their sub-resources.
  • PUT/POST /Marti/api/missions/logs/entries — append to a mission log.

Uploading files (Enterprise Sync)

Store a file/data package in Enterprise Sync and you get back a hash you can then reference from missions or CoT:

  • Upload the content to the Enterprise Sync store (see the spec for the exact upload path and the hash/name parameters).
  • PUT /Marti/api/sync/metadata/{hash}/{metadata}, …/{hash}/keywords, …/{hash}/expiration — attach/adjust metadata after upload.

Provisioning & other writes

  • GET/PUT/POST /Marti/api/device/profile/{name} (+ /file, /directories/{…}) — device profiles that provision connecting EUDs (mainly ATAK). They push EUD settings — Update Server config, maps, toolbars — to users in specified groups, applied on enrollment (when a device first gets its certificate) or on connection (whenever it reconnects). The settings are typically .pref files inside a TAK data package (so ATAK auto-imports them). See the Device Profiles wiki page for the operator view.
  • POST /Marti/api/tls/signClient / …/v2 — TAK Server can sign a client CSR directly. On a Deploy App deployment you normally get your cert from Deploy App instead — see Enrolling & getting a client certificate.

Group discipline. Writing to a group you don't have write (In) membership in won't reach anyone. If a push "succeeds" but no one sees it, check your group membership first (Keycloak: identity & groups). Writing into a mission additionally needs a ReadWrite or Owner role on that mission (see Getting data → roles & groups).
